UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Stores user tracking data for cards, lounge passes, and offers

exhaustedCards.description: Map of card ID to boolean indicating if max spend is exhausted

loungePassesUsed.description: Map of card ID + lounge tab to number of passes used

loungeMilestonesVerified.description: Map of card ID + lounge tab to boolean indicating if milestone is met

offerUsage.description: Map of card ID + category + value to number of uses

users/{userId}.description: User profile data including cards tracking.
